integrity: The exact variational threshold and contact coefficient are proved analytically. A Python standard-library checker supplies corroboration, not an infinite proof or historical-priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Only centroidal sections of solid three-dimensional capped right circular paraboloids are covered. No uniqueness of oblique maximizing slope, certified decimal enclosure, noisy-data stability, or higher-dimensional analogue is claimed.
title: A first-order maximum-section transition and a sharp contact cusp for capped paraboloids
